tool_arguments.prompt:
Create a wide one-row THREE-column sprite sheet containing EXACTLY THREE full-body axolotl mascot poses, left to right, all separated by wide TRUE transparent gutters. Original fresh drawing, not a pixel edit. Input is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference. Same pale pink axolotl: THREE existing external gill branches attached on EACH side of head, two existing arms and feet, exactly one finned tail at viewer-right; exact white eye surrounds/brown pupils with no new highlight. Preserve reference head WIDTH/HEIGHT, torso LENGTH/WIDTH, same standing height and ground support between poses. Use same simple slightly anthropomorphic round large-head/short-body world, warm brown thin outline and light watercolor texture strictly inside subject. Do not add ears, extra gills, duplicate arms, props, water, floor, paper rectangle or background. Highest native resolution available, requested3072 wide. These are the only three poses: 1. BLINK: Same canonical upright resting body and limb positions; ONLY both eyes gently fully closed, no head/body shrink or stretch. 2. GREET: One existing forepaw raised in a gentle greeting, the other at side, both feet planted. 3. PRESENT_LEFT: One attached forepaw and gaze indicate viewer LEFT, no prop. A fourth/neutral pose is prohibited, it is reused from the reference. Complete gills/tail/feet with generous margins. 
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.

record_scope: Selected source only. Historical candidate/QA files are source-workspace history, not bundled dependencies.
